title: 2 Hour Kayak Lessons On Lady Bird Lake
includes: Use of kayak, paddles, and life jackets
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Easy rentals at a low price, we handle everything except the paddling. Easy and convenient location right by the water, we bring the boats right to the water and make sure you are completely set up before launching you out. During your rental you will be able to see stunning views of downtown Austin from the lake, the iconic Congress Avenue bat bridge, and the ability to immerse yourself in the surrounding wildlife. Truly an unforgettable experience.
